## Work Schedule

## Environmental Conditions

Office

## Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

As an **Associate Project Manager** at Thermo Fisher Scientific's Clinical Trials Division, you will contribute to ensuring successful delivery of clinical trial projects and exceptional customer service. Working autonomously or supporting senior project managers, you will manage a portfolio of clinical trial projects, coordinating cross-functional activities from study setup through completion while serving as the primary point of contact for clients.

## Your responsibilities:

- Manage end-to-end project coordination, including study specifications, timeline development, budget management, and documentation
• Foster proactive communication and collaboration between internal departments and external clients
• Ensure timely delivery of services and products according to client requirements and quality standards
• Monitor project activities, identify and address risks, and implement solutions to keep projects on track
• Develop strong client relationships while representing their needs throughout internal processes
• Support continuous improvement initiatives and provide guidance to team members **Your Qualification:**
• Advanced Degree with no prior experience, or Bachelor's Degree plus 2 years of experience, preferably in clinical trials or pharmaceutical industry
• Preferred Fields of Study: life sciences, healthcare, business or related field
• Project Management certification preferred
• Strong understanding of GMP/GxP requirements and quality management systems
• Excellent organizational and planning abilities with demonstrated experience managing multiple complex projects
• Advanced communication and presentation skills; able to effectively engage with clients and internal stakeholders
• Proficient in project management tools and MS Office applications (Excel, PowerPoint, etc.)
• Experience with relevant systems like Salesforce, GPMS, TrackWise preferred
• Demonstrated financial acumen and budget management capabilities
• Analytical approach with ability to identify and address risks
• Detail-oriented with excellent documentation and process compliance skills
• Self-directed while collaborating effectively in a matrix environment
• English fluency required; additional languages beneficial
• Travel required 10-25%
• Client-focused with demonstrated ability to build and maintain professional relationships

**We offer** competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!

Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Watch as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation, and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need. #StartYourStory at Thermo Fisher Scientific, where diverse experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.

Apply today! http://jobs.thermofisher.com

• Campi di studio preferiti: scienze della vita, sanità, business o campo relativo
• Certificazione Project Management preferita
• Forte comprensione dei requisiti GMP/GxP e dei sistemi di gestione della qualità
• Eccellente capacità organizzative e di pianificazione con esperienza dimostrata di gestione di progetti complessi
• Capacità di comunicazione e presentazione avanzate; in grado di interagire efficacemente con i clienti e gli stakeholder interni
• Proficiente negli strumenti di gestione del progetto e applicazioni MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, ecc.)
• Esperienza con sistemi rilevanti come Salesforce, GPMS, TrackWise ha preferito
• Acume finanziario e capacità di gestione del bilancio
• Approccio analitico con capacità di identificare e affrontare i rischi
• Dettaglio orientato con eccellente documentazione e competenze di conformità del processo
• Autodiretto mentre collabora efficacemente in un ambiente matrice
• Fluency inglese richiesto; lingue aggiuntive vantaggiose
• Viaggi richiesto 10-25%
• Clienti focalizzati sulla capacità dimostrata di costruire e mantenere relazioni professionali ** Offriamo ** remunerazione competitiva, bonus annuale di piano di incentivazione, assistenza sanitaria e una gamma di benefici per i dipendenti. Thermo Fisher Scientific offre un'occupazione con un'organizzazione innovativa e intenzionale, e prospettive di carriera e sviluppo eccezionali. Offriamo un'emozionante cultura aziendale che è sinonimo di integrità, intensità, coinvolgimento e innovazione! La nostra missione è quella di consentire ai nostri clienti di rendere il mondo più sano, più pulito e più sicuro. Guarda come i nostri colleghi spiegano 5 motivi per lavorare con noi. Come un team di 100.000+ colleghi, condividiamo un insieme comune di valori - Integrità, Intensità, Innovazione e Coinvolgimento - lavorando insieme per accelerare la ricerca, risolvere complesse sfide scientifiche, guidare l'innovazione tecnologica e sostenere i pazienti bisognosi. #StartYourStory at Thermo Fisher Scientific, dove vengono valutate esperienze, sfondi e prospettive diverse. Join our team at Thermo Fisher Scientific and contribute to advancing clinical research in a fixed-term role. As a Project Support Associate, you will support clinical trials by coordinating project activities, managing documentation, and contributing to supply chain operations.

- Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, healthcare, supply chain, business, or a related field
- Initial professional experience in clinical trials, clinical supply, logistics, or a related regulated industry
- Experience in coordination, administrative, operational, or client-facing roles
- Project Management certification from recognized institution beneficial
• Strong understanding of GMP/GxP principles and quality management systems
- Strong organizational and multitasking skills with high attention to detail
- Ability to coordinate multiple activities and meet timelines in a dynamic environment
- Experience coordinating with teams and managing stakeholder relationships
- Analytical mindset with the ability to work with data and support reporting
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (especially Excel and MS Project)
- Experience with enterprise systems like Salesforce, GPMS, and TrackWise preferred
- Fluent English required, additional languages beneficial
- Proactive, adaptable, and quality-focused approach

## Job Description

## Job Summary:

This position is responsible for ensuring operational EHS at the site and actively supports the implementation of EHS regulations and corporate requirements at the site level through various projects.

This position is also responsible for compliance with environmental regulations and emergency measures at the site and supports the site's operations and warehouse with fire protection and corresponding emergency planning. The EHS Sr. Specialist is the main point of contact for chemical accident and fire prevention at the site level within the framework of various projects.

The EHS Sr. Specialist works closely with all departments, by creating risk assessments, storage and preservation concepts, and training staff in safe behaviour.

## Main tasks:

- You support the departments in the implementation of EHS guidelines based on corporate requirements as well as national and local Swiss regulations.
- You support and advise departments and functional managers regarding EHS guidelines, procedures, standards, and regulatory requirements.
- You monitor and ensure the effectiveness of EHS standards on site by conducting regular inspections.
- You take on the management of operational occupational hygiene and coordinate monitoring campaigns with external service providers.
- You create a prevention program and conduct EHS training, advertising, and communication to improve employees' awareness and competence in the EHS area.
- You ensure the introduction and targeted training of new tools - especially digital tools - that are to be used by employees at the site.
- You lead the Safety Committee at the site, which is composed of representatives from various departments.
- You will work closely with the energy team at the site to drive energy-saving projects forward.
- Together with FM, you will develop and maintain an effective training plan for contractors.
- You prepare exercises and ensure the effectiveness of emergency measures.
- You support and advise the warehouse in creating an appropriate storage concept.
- You take over the management of the first aid organization on site and train staff in firefighting and emergency measures.
- You organize and lead the emergency response team (evacuations)
- Together with facility management, you support the maintenance, inspection, and documentation of safety equipment on site, in particular
- Sprinkler system
- First aid equipment
- Fire alarm system
- You participate in the annual review of risk management and the claims insurance advisor.
- You conduct campaigns for fire and emergency prevention.
- You are part of the on-site emergency team.
- No travel requirements

## Requirements/Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Chemistry, Environmental Science, or a related field, with additional training in Occupational Safety, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
- At least 5 years of experience in Environment, Health & Safety (EHS).
- Strong knowledge of local occupational health and safety regulations.
- Experience in the chemical and/or pharmaceutical industry.
- Experience in occupational/industrial hygiene.
- Knowledge of biological hazards and biosafety is an advantage.
- Demonstrated ability to drive EHS initiatives, proactively engage relevant stakeholders, and foster a strong safety culture across the organization.
- Applies a practical and solution-focused mindset to support business objectives while consistently upholding regulatory and company standards.
- Acts as a trusted EHS advisor and primary point of contact, providing timely, practical, and effective guidance on EHS-related questions and challenges.
- Proven ability to influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization, both vertically and cross-functionally.
- Strong training, coaching, and problem-solving skills.
- Excellent organizational skills with the ability to prioritize effectively and manage multiple stakeholders and competing demands.
- Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across all organizational levels.
- Excellent oral and written communication skills.
- Fluent in German with good English language skills.
- Self-motivated with the ability to work independently, take ownership, and achieve goals within demanding timelines.

## Riepilogo del lavoro:

Questa posizione è responsabile di garantire l'EHS operativo sul sito e supporta attivamente l'implementazione di normative EHS e requisiti aziendali a livello del sito attraverso vari progetti.

Questa posizione è anche responsabile del rispetto delle normative ambientali e delle misure di emergenza sul sito e supporta le operazioni del sito e il magazzino con protezione antincendio e corrispondente pianificazione di emergenza. Lo specialista EHS Sr. è il punto principale di contatto per incidenti chimici e prevenzione antincendio a livello del sito nell'ambito di vari progetti.

Lo specialista EHS Sr. lavora a stretto contatto con tutti i dipartimenti, creando valutazioni di rischio, concetti di conservazione e conservazione e personale di formazione in comportamento sicuro.

## Principali compiti:

- L'utente sostiene i dipartimenti nell'attuazione delle linee guida EHS in base alle esigenze aziendali e alle normative svizzere nazionali e locali.
- L'utente supporta e consiglia i dipartimenti e i gestori funzionali per quanto riguarda le linee guida, le procedure, gli standard e i requisiti normativi.
- Monitorare e garantire l'efficacia degli standard EHS in loco conducendo ispezioni regolari.
- Accetti la gestione dell'igiene del lavoro e coordina le campagne di monitoraggio con i fornitori di servizi esterni.
- Creare un programma di prevenzione e condurre la formazione, la pubblicità e la comunicazione EHS per migliorare la consapevolezza e la competenza dei dipendenti nell'area EHS.
- Assicura l'introduzione e la formazione mirata di nuovi strumenti - soprattutto strumenti digitali - che devono essere utilizzati dai dipendenti del sito.
- Lei guida il comitato di sicurezza sul sito, che è composto da rappresentanti di vari dipartimenti.
- Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con il team di energia del sito per guidare i progetti di risparmio energetico in avanti.
- Insieme con FM, si svilupperà e manterrà un piano di formazione efficace per gli appaltatori.

- Si organizza e guida il team di risposta di emergenza (evacuazioni)

- Sistema di spruzzi
- Attrezzature di pronto soccorso
- Sistema di allarme antincendio
- Partecipa alla revisione annuale della gestione del rischio e del consulente di assicurazione crediti.
- Conduci campagne di prevenzione incendi e di emergenza.
- Fai parte del team di emergenza in loco.
- Nessun requisito di viaggio

## Requisiti/Qualificazioni:

- Corso di laurea in Ingegneria, Chimica, Scienze Ambientali, o un campo correlato, con formazione aggiuntiva in Sicurezza del Lavoro, o una combinazione equivalente di istruzione e esperienza professionale.
- Almeno 5 anni di esperienza in Ambiente, Salute e Sicurezza (EHS).
- Forte conoscenza delle normative locali in materia di salute e sicurezza sul lavoro.
- Esperienza nell'industria chimica e/o farmaceutica.
- Esperienza nell'igiene professionale/industriale.
- La conoscenza dei pericoli biologici e della biosicurezza è un vantaggio.
- Dimostrata capacità di guidare iniziative EHS, coinvolgere proattivamente le parti interessate pertinenti e promuovere una forte cultura della sicurezza in tutta l'organizzazione.
- Si basa su una mentalità pratica e orientata alla soluzione per supportare gli obiettivi aziendali, mantenendo costantemente gli standard normativi e aziendali.
- Agisce come consulente EHS di fiducia e punto di contatto primario, fornendo una guida tempestiva, pratica ed efficace sulle domande e le sfide relative alla EHS.
- Prove capacità di influenzare gli stakeholder a tutti i livelli dell'organizzazione, sia verticalmente che cross-funzionalmente.
- Forte formazione, coaching e capacità di problem solving.
- Eccellente capacità organizzativa con la capacità di priorità in modo efficace e gestire più stakeholder e richieste concorrenti.
- Competenze interpersonali e di comunicazione eccezionali, con la capacità di collaborare efficacemente a tutti i livelli organizzativi.
- Eccellente capacità di comunicazione orale e scritta.
- Fluente in tedesco con buone abilità di lingua inglese.
- Automotivata con la capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente, prendere la proprietà e raggiungere gli obiettivi entro tempi difficili.

## Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer. **Description:**

Join our team at Thermo Fisher Scientific and contribute to advancing clinical research. As a Client Services Project Manager I, you'll support clinical trials by managing project documentation, coordinating supply chain activities, and ensuring consistent delivery of services. Work closely with internal teams and clients to support study success while maintaining the highest quality standards. You'll handle project planning, documentation management, and cross-functional coordination to meet timelines and client expectations.

## Your Role in that Mission:

As a member of Global Client Services, you are part of One Global Team: Empowered to Act, Make Connections and Get Results for our customers and their patients.

The Project Support Associate is a key member of our Project Management team and provides crucial support which enables unparalleled service to our clients. This role partners with internal and external customers to monitor the daily progress of client project results and plays a key role in documentation and ensuring an excellent customer experience. The PSA role supports the PM client portfolio to ensure successful completion and supply maintenance over the life cycle of each project.

## Key Responsibilities:

- Partners with the internal project management team to help support the success of a study in any way possible.
- Assists in setting up and maintaining study filing systems and maintains accurate records for all work undertaken, working with appropriate quality management systems.
- Collaborates with the Project Manager for ensuring that all Fisher Clinical activities come together in a timely manner to meet the customer and study requirements.
- Gets results through the use of appropriate project planning tools to communicate achievements and critical path activities and responsibilities.
- Creates and/ or supports creation of operational documentation using internal systems including but not limited to GMP operational documentation. Build bill of materials and coordinates creation and review of billing packages.
- Collects all information on a study design including; accurate label texts, coordination of primary, secondary packaging material and tools, coordination of label translation, producing all batch documentation for operations and check of documentation and GMP instructions.
- Applies GXP in all areas of responsibility7

## As Demonstrated By:

Project Management

- General understanding of project plans and timeline management with a demonstrated track record for task delivery to enable achievement of goals.
- Knowledge of general inventory, good documentation practices, and report generation.
- Identifies and raises project challenges and collaborates with team members or management to resolve issues.
- Communicates information in a timely manner, understands boundaries, respects differences and addresses challenging situations appropriately.

## Requirements:

- Bachelor's degree required, no prior experience required, preferably in clinical trials or pharmaceutical industry
- Preferred Fields of Study: healthcare, supply chain management, life sciences, or related field
- Strong understanding of GMP/GxP principles and quality management systems
- Demonstrated project management skills with ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office suite, especially Excel and Project
- Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
- Effective written and verbal communication skills
- Detail-oriented with excellent organizational and documentation abilities
- Demonstrated ability to work independently and as part of cross-functional teams
- Fluent English required, additional languages beneficial
- Experience coordinating with teams and managing stakeholder relationships
- Ability to analyze data and generate clear, accurate reports
- Focus on quality service and continuous improvement
- Adaptable to changing priorities while maintaining attention to detail

## Work Schedule

## Environmental Conditions

Office

## Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

## Position Summary:

This is an outstanding chance for a committed and ambitious professional to join our project management team at Thermo Fisher Scientific in Allschwil. The Senior Project Manager, Client Services Distribution leads all aspects of leadership and is responsible for the actions of project managers and project support associates. You will work closely to guarantee the timely and flawless delivery of clinical supplies projects and successfully implement processes to improve efficiency. While you will not coordinate day-to-day project activities, you will lead all aspects of your team's client portfolio, ensuring outstanding client happiness and consistent business delivery.

## Key Responsibilities:

- Develop, mentor, and conduct yearly evaluations for Project Managers, Associate Project Managers, and Project Support Associates. Put into effect Performance Improvement Plans when needed.
- Establish goals for direct reports in alignment with company initiatives and vision.
- Direct the selection of projects and clients managed by the project management team, ensuring accurate and consistent delivery of customer projects.
- Provide assistance for customer issues advanced by Project Managers and Associate Project Managers.
- Identify, develop, and implement process improvements to improve overall efficiency and productivity.
- Address all personnel issues, timecard maintenance, and job descriptions for support associates.
- Participate in sales and marketing activities, including customer kickoffs, teleconferences, customer visits, audits, estimates, and quotations.
- Initiate and maintain continuous communication with appropriate departments.
- Provide regular training, including system and SOP training.
- Adhere to Good Manufacturing Practices in all areas of responsibility.
- Demonstrate and promote the company vision and values.

## Minimum Requirements/Qualifications:

- Accredited degree, preferably in a health-related field; advanced degree preferred.
- 5-7 years of experience supporting project management teams.
- Previous work experience in the Healthcare field required.
- 2 years of management experience.
- Strong interpersonal and communication skills, including excellent relationship building.
- Proven experience managing teams and working with customers in dynamic environments.
- In-depth understanding of clinical trials and business services.
- Proficient in using company SOPs and Quality standards.
- Excellent organizational, planning, and analytical skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet strict deadlines.
- Strong customer management skills; proactive in anticipating and responding to client needs.
- Experience with both detailed execution and strategic orientation.

## Diversity and Inclusion Proficiencies:

- Drives Growth
- Builds Customer Allegiance
- Communicates Openly
- Builds Organizational Relationships
- Adapts to Process Improvement Environments

## Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

## Environmental Conditions

Office

## Job Description

*Thermo Fisher Scientific Clinical Trials Division (CTD) is a rapidly growing, dynamic end-to-end pharma services platform that is seeking sharp individuals to bring the highest quality processes, products and testing to our clients. Our employees are committed to making a difference in our organization, for our client partners and the patients we serve.*

## The job:

The Regional Director, Engineering provides strategic engineering leadership across the region (Americas or EMEA) ensuring engineering capability, capital investment, asset reliability, infrastructure planning, and engineering governance support the long-term growth of the Clinical Trials Division. Reporting to the Senior Director of Engineering for CTD, this role is accountable for developing regional engineering strategy, leading the regional capital portfolio, driving engineering standards, enabling operational excellence, and building organizational capability across the engineering network.

The Regional Director partners closely with regional business leaders, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Global Engineering and site leadership to ensure engineering investments are aligned with business priorities while delivering safe, compliant, reliable and scalable operations.

This role can be based at either our Allschwill (Switzerland), or Horsham (UK) sites. It provides oversight to all CTD locations within the EMEA region. Significant time may be spent at the appropriate CTD facilities within the region, including up to 50% travel to network locations globally.

## What will you do?

## Strategic Leadership

- Develop and execute the regional engineering strategy aligned with CTD business objectives, driving long-term infrastructure, engineering capability, and operational excellence across the regional network.
- Lead regional engineering planning, including site master plans, multi-year capital investment strategies, and engineering roadmaps that support business growth, capacity expansion, and business continuity.
- Drive standardization and governance by establishing consistent engineering standards, project governance, and best practices while ensuring alignment with global engineering initiatives and regulatory requirements.
- Partner with regional and global leadership to prioritize strategic investments, develop engineering organizational capability, and build a high-performing engineering culture through talent development, succession planning, and cross-functional collaboration.

## Technical Leadership

- Provide strategic engineering leadership to regional sites, ensuring facilities, utilities, equipment, automation, and infrastructure support safe, compliant, and efficient operations.
- Drive engineering excellence by standardizing technical practices, promoting innovation, and leveraging enterprise expertise to improve reliability, scalability, and operational performance.
- Lead technical risk management, including asset lifecycle planning, infrastructure modernization, sustainability initiatives, and engineering support for business growth and client opportunities.
- Develop engineering capability by coaching engineering leaders, fostering technical excellence, and building a strong pipeline of engineering talent across the region.

## Capital Portfolio & Project Management

- Own the regional capital investment portfolio, establishing priorities that align with strategic business objectives, regulatory requirements, and operational needs.
- Lead capital governance by ensuring consistent project management standards, portfolio reviews, business case development, and effective allocation of engineering resources.
- Ensure successful project execution by driving delivery to scope, schedule, budget, quality, and operational readiness while proactively managing project risks.
- Monitor portfolio performance through standardized metrics, financial oversight, and executive reporting to ensure achievement of business value and return on investment.

## Engineering Governance & Operational Excellence

- Establish and sustain regional engineering governance, driving standardized engineering processes, decision-making, and compliance with corporate engineering standards.
- Lead operational excellence initiatives focused on maintenance and reliability, asset utilization, predictive maintenance, and continuous improvement across the regional network.
- Drive implementation of engineering standards for capital execution, equipment lifecycle management, and facility operations to improve consistency and operational performance.
- Measure and improve engineering performance through KPIs, bench-marking, and data-driven initiatives that enhance reliability, productivity, and cost effectiveness.

## Who we are looking for:

## Education:

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline required.
- Master's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
- Professional Engineering (PE), Chartered Engineer (CEng), or Project Management certification (PMP) is desirable.

## Experience:

- 10+ years of related experience in the Pharmaceutical or related industry including experience in engineering, operations, program and project management.
- 5+ years of experience in a functional leadership position within two or more areas including Process Engineering, Facilities/Engineering, Maintenance, Automation, I&C, Validation or related functions.
- Expertise in design, qualification, and operation of facilities, utilities, equipment, along with automation used in the Manufacturing and Packaging of Clinical Trials.
- Experience in building and leading high-performing teams to deliver results.
- Understanding of applicable regulatory requirements and industry guidance (esp. FDA, EMA, ICH, ISPE). Audit experienced is preferred.
- Familiar with current issues and trends related to clinical trials and FDA regulations.

## Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:

- Strategic leadership with the ability to develop long-term engineering strategies, prioritize investments, and align engineering initiatives with business objectives.
- Executive influence and collaboration, with exceptional communication skills and the ability to build strong partnerships across Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Commercial, and Executive Leadership.
- Strong business and financial acumen, including capital planning, portfolio management, risk assessment, and data-driven decision making.
- Proven people leadership, with demonstrated success developing talent, leading through change, driving accountability, and fostering a culture of engagement, innovation, and continuous improvement.

## What’s in it for you:

We offer competitive remuneration, an annual incentive plan bonus scheme and a range of employee benefits! Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation.
